repos_data.description: Enable any LLM (e.g. Claude) to interactively debug any language for you via MCP and a VS Code Extension

Talk to Claude Code instead of typing: a voice daemon + dashboard that records you, transcribes, routes to your agent sessions, and speaks the replies back - with per-voice avatars, push-to-talk hotkeys, and a live conversation HUD
Share and collaborate on local markdown files via shareable links
MCP server with persistent memory + FTS5 search for Claude Code conversation history. Index your ~/.claude/projects/, expose 10 MCP tools, browse via web UI. MIT-licensed.
Rollback and safety for AI coding agents and vibe coders: flag risky changes and restore project files, including uncommitted work, to their pre-session state.
The Vibe Coding Kit — a shareable Claude Code framework (BOOTSTRAP + Vibe Board MCP + optional VE Worker). Drop-in skills, RIPER workflow, /review-* audit family. Companion to HuntsDesk/ve-gws.
Bring Warp™ Oz™ to any IDE or agent via MCP — plus native @oz in VS Code Copilot Chat. OzBridge is an independent project and is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or sponsored by Warp.

Claude Code is an agentic coding tool that lives in your terminal, understands your codebase, and helps you code faster by executing routine tasks, explaining complex code, and handling git workflows - all through natural language commands.
This repo includes Claude prompt curation to use Claude better.
MCP server that adds RAG-powered AI chat to any website. One command from Claude Code. Local vector store, multi-provider LLM (OpenAI/Anthropic/Gemini). Zero cloud dependency.

45+ tips for getting the most out of Claude Code, from basics to advanced - includes a custom status line script and Claude Code running itself in a container. Also includes the dx plugin: skills for everyday dev workflows.
